publicationExtensions.walkCommits: caller stop set, ordered parents, tree, bounded opaque continuation
publicationExtensions.compareAndSwap: expected and next are independently Absent or Oid
publicationExtensions.remote: explicit RemoteGrant with pinned effective URL; bounded borrowed transport; mirror refs installed by no-dereference exact-old CAS
publicationExtensions.resolveHead: Inspect policy without borrowing holder authority; worktree-specific attached/detached/unborn facts
publicationExtensions.listTree: Inspect policy without borrowing holder authority; recursive typed byte paths, literal prefix, revision/query-bound bounded pages; 64 MiB capture refusal

publicationAuthority: HolderAuthority takes an exclusive mutable borrow of an acquired opaque event-seal Handle; !Sync; validate before Intent and every child; no fd input

worktree.create: full immutable base, optional new branch, validated session id; detached parent/session allocation uses mkdtemp; worker .fgos stripped and intentionally absent paths marked skip-worktree
worktree.remove: one rank-40 hold; identity, live cwd, custody, full status, pending WAL, expected tip, delivery ancestry and evidence digest; no force or recursive fallback
worktree.recovery: operation-specific registration/inode evidence; recorded destination only; no repeated TargetAttempt; unknown and dirty residues preserved
worktree.doctor: git-worktree-recovery is read-only; phase 04 adds custody diagnostics to the same row
